summary: The Philistine rulers paid Delilah to find out the secret of Samson's strength. She kept pressuring him day after day until he finally told her: his hair had never been cut.

story_reel.narration: Later, Samson fell in love with a woman named Delilah. The five rulers of the Philistines came to her with a deal. 'Find out the secret of Samson's great strength, and how we can capture him. Each of us will give you eleven hundred pieces of silver!' That was a fortune! So Delilah asked Samson, 'Tell me the secret of your strength.' Samson teased her. 'If they tie me with seven fresh bowstrings, I'll be as weak as anyone.' So she tied him up with bowstrings and shouted, 'Samson, the Philistines are here!' He snapped them like string. Then he said, 'Use new ropes.' Snap! Then, 'Weave my hair into the loom.' He pulled the whole loom away! Delilah pouted. 'How can you say you love me when you won't trust me?' Day after day, she nagged and pressured him, until he was sick of it. Finally, Samson told her everything. 'No razor has ever touched my head, because I've been a Nazirite to God since birth. If my head is shaved, my strength will leave me.' Samson knew Delilah was trying to trap him, but he told her anyway. He didn't guard his heart.

memory_verse.text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can guard my heart and choose friends who help me follow Yahweh.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Delilah kept pressuring Samson until he gave in. What can you do when someone keeps pressuring you to do something wrong?

quiz.question: How much silver did each Philistine ruler offer Delilah?
quiz.explanation: They said, 'We will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.'

quiz.question: What did Delilah say when Samson wouldn't tell her his secret?
options: 'How can you say you love me?'
quiz.explanation: She said, 'How can you say, I love you, when your heart is not with me?'

quiz.question: What was the secret Samson finally told?
options: His hair had never been cut because he was a Nazirite
quiz.explanation: Samson said, 'No razor has ever come on my head; for I have been a Nazirite to God.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, help me guard my heart. Give me wisdom to choose good friends and courage to say no when someone pressures me to do wrong. Amen.

companion.message: Samson was strong enough to break ropes, but not strong enough to walk away from pressure. Real strength is saying no and choosing friends who help you follow God.

review.notes: Samson and Delilah's relationship is described only as 'fell in love.' Pressure is framed for kids with a trusted-grown-up option. Confirm.
